title: A converse to Littlewood-type theorem for random Dirichlet series
summary: This article investigates random Dirichlet series within the framework of Hardy and mixed norm spaces of Dirichlet series. We completely characterize when the random symbol space of the Hardy space $\mathscr{H}^p$ coincides with $\mathscr{H}^2$. In the setting of mixed norm spaces $\mathscr{H}^{p,q}_α$, the corresponding characterizations for the random symbol space of $\mathscr{H}^{p,q}_α$ coinciding with $\mathscr{H}^{2,q}_α$ are given when $q\geq4$, and some sufficient and necessary conditions are established when $q<4$.
